title: My Beloved Withdrew Himself
summary: This is the alternation: the Lord, having entered the inmost, withdraws so that the soul may discover what the first conjunction could not yet reach. The structures that guided the seeking now wound; the veil of external truth is stripped; the soul is left in longing — and from that longing the deeper seeking begins. The work that follows is the longest in the corpus, and it narrates that deeper work in its full architecture. It opens with the self-claim's auto-genesis — Hyle as Enthumesis of Death generating from herself — and the measured times that bound the natural. It lays out the parallel emanations of light and the riddle of the self-claim's five-formed body; the twelve judges and twelve thrones of the Lord's discrimination; the three garments of the Living Spirit and the descent through the soul's members; the seven, the five, and the four works performed within the captive body; the mirror wheel and the nested zones; the cosmic body, the forming of Adam, and the soul bound in the twelve members; the three days, the two deaths, the three plagues; the three malformations and their cleansing through descent and ascent; and the four ages, the five wheels, the three wells through which what was deeply held is at last brought up. The whole is the wound and what the wound makes possible.
organizing_principle: The teachings unfold the deeper work that the first conjunction has exposed. The arc moves from cause through anatomy through operation through resolution. First the cause: Hyle's self-molding — the self-claim has organized everything that the first reception did not reach — and the measured times that bound the natural. Then the anatomy: the parallel emanations one beside another, the self-claim's five-formed body, the twelve judges and thrones by which discrimination strikes. Then the operation: the Living Spirit's three garments, the soul's twelvefold binding and the New Man's exchange, the seven works of building, the five works set within the self-claim's body, and the four works of the Ambassador's revealing. The teachings then deepen into the cosmic body: the mirror wheel, the nested zones, the natural mind shaped as one anthropomorphic captive body, Adam formed from the Watchers' residue, the soul bound and exchanged member by member. The temporal weight is brought next — three Great Days, two Deaths, the three afflictions by which what the self has claimed is undone — followed by the central operation of cleansing: three malformations cleansed by descent-and-ascent, the Father's pre-prepared containments. The closing teachings give the structural completions — what the Lord prepares beforehand, the four registers and turning wheel, the three conduits by which influx descends and life ascends. The section's length is its accuracy: the alternation is where most of regeneration happens, and the corpus knows this exactly.
